pros: Fast setup - minutes to a live dashboard.
Free registration and a demo account.
cons: Marketing numbers that the fine print walks back.
No independent audit of the models.
redFlags: Marketing numbers the fine print quietly qualifies.
A support bullet that garbles two claims at once.
Performance language with no dates attached.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$250, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.
12 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.

faqs.q: Does it offer a demo account?
faqs.a: Yes - a practice account is part of the package and runs alongside the live balance, which is the sensible first step before risking the US$250 minimum.
The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.

bottomLine: The verdict on the product is cautious approval: it works, it includes a demo, and it should be used with the minimum deposit while the claims are unproven.
The final score lands at 4.7 - a capable platform held back by its own paperwork. Start small, verify the claims yourself and never trade money you cannot lose.
